name: recordId
label: Sys id of the record
description: Sys id of the record being opened in wizard

name: mode
label: Wizard mode
description: Wizard operating modes - Normal Mode: on submit, wizard produces target records. Template Mode: wizard produces a template for the backing record producer

name: hideHomeButton
label: Hide Home button
description: Hides the Home button on the wizard.

name: isTemplateMandatory
label: Make template mandatory
description: If selected (True), you must provide a valid template ID to create target records. This applies to normal mode only.

name: fieldSpace
label: Field space
description: The fieldSpace property enables you to select the spacing between questions in the Wizard section.

name: hideBackButton
label: Hide step navigator Back button
description: When true, the step navigator Back button will not be visible

name: hideForwardButton
label: Hide step navigator Forward button
description: When true, the step navigator Forward (Continue) button will not be visible

name: forwardButtonType
label: Step navigator forward button type
description: Select to set the navigator Forward button type

name: homeButtonIcon
label: Home Button Icon
description: Pick an icon that appears in place of the home button at the top of the wizard

name: homeButtonTooltip
label: Home Button Tooltip
description: Add your own tooltip text to assist users

name: daClientActionContract
label: DA Client Action Contract
description: The contract that UI Builder uses to dynamically build the available declarative actions for event mapping
